name: Zuperix DAM
author: Zuperix

sections.description:
Zuperix is a modern AI-powered Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform built for fast-moving marketing, ecommerce, and content teams.

This official WordPress plugin connects your website directly to the Zuperix cloud DAM, allowing you to manage, search, and deliver media assets globally without cluttering your WordPress uploads folder.

Instead of managing scattered files across multiple websites, cloud drives, and folders, Zuperix gives your team a centralized AI-powered media library with:

  • Semantic AI search
  • AI-generated asset tags
  • OCR text recognition
  • Global CDN delivery
  • Cross-platform asset management
  • WordPress, Canva, and Figma integrations

Search media like ChatGPT.

Find assets using natural language queries such as:

  • “football players celebrating”
  • “minimal product mockup”
  • “modern office workspace”
  • “summer campaign banner”

No more digging through folders or remembering exact filenames.

Why Zuperix?

Most media libraries rely on:
– manual folders
– filenames
– traditional tags

Zuperix uses AI to understand the actual content inside your assets.

This means:
– faster content discovery
– better organization
– fewer duplicate uploads
– easier collaboration
– scalable asset management

Whether you manage:
– ecommerce products
– marketing creatives
– blog media
– social assets
– brand libraries

Zuperix helps teams organize and find assets instantly.

Key Features

✅ AI Semantic Search
Search images using natural language instead of filenames or folders.

✅ AI Auto-Tagging
Automatically generate searchable metadata and smart tags for uploaded assets.

✅ OCR Text Recognition
Extract searchable text from screenshots, graphics, PDFs, and marketing creatives.

✅ Global CDN Delivery
Serve assets directly from the Zuperix CDN for faster websites and lower server load.

✅ Centralized Asset Library
Upload once and use assets across multiple websites and teams.

✅ Gutenberg Integration
Browse and insert DAM assets directly inside the WordPress block editor.

✅ Classic Media Library Integration
Adds a dedicated “Zuperix DAM” tab to the standard WordPress media modal.

✅ Automatic Upload Sync
New uploads are automatically pushed into your Zuperix workspace.

✅ Optional Local Fallback
Fallback to local WordPress storage if the DAM becomes temporarily unavailable.

✅ Secure & API-First
Built with nonce-protected AJAX endpoints and secure API architecture.

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin.
  2. Connect your Zuperix account using an API key.
  3. Upload assets directly from WordPress.
  4. Files sync automatically to your Zuperix DAM.
  5. Search and reuse assets instantly using AI-powered semantic search.

WordPress stores lightweight media references while files are delivered globally through the Zuperix CDN.

Perfect For

  • Marketing teams
  • Agencies
  • Ecommerce brands
  • Content creators
  • Multi-site WordPress networks
  • Design teams
  • Media-heavy websites

Learn More

🎯 Figma Integration: https://www.figma.com/community

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Zuperix DAM.
  4. Enter your Zuperix API URL and API Key.
  5. Start uploading and searching assets instantly.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the WordPress Media Library?

No. Zuperix integrates directly into the WordPress media workflow while adding AI-powered DAM capabilities.

Are files stored locally on my server?

Assets are primarily served through the Zuperix CDN. Optional local fallback storage is available.

Does this support Gutenberg?

Yes. Zuperix integrates directly into the block editor experience.

Can I search images using natural language?

Yes. Semantic AI search allows queries like:
– “team celebration”
– “modern workspace”
– “blue sneakers”
– “marketing presentation”

Does Zuperix support OCR?

Yes. Text inside uploaded images can become searchable automatically.
